simulation.centre_of_mass: volume-weighted centroid of real connected-component convex hulls
simulation.active_collision: rigid compound of connected-component convex hulls; single connected meshes use a single hull
simulation.neighbors: New mixed drops may use temporary actual-mesh neighbours for trajectory guidance, then remove them for final own-region-only Bullet settling. Accepted rounded poses must remain disjoint and supported only by frame or earlier own copies.
simulation.initial_orientation: independent random yaw, roll and tilt; original accepted starts retained in physics-cache-r5b
simulation.freeze: earlier same-region copies frozen as actual meshes; every accepted copy checked for real contact

provenance.prefix_reuse: Per-row prefix_provenance identifies inherited genuine r5 poses at unchanged fits, their original seed and source JSON hash. Original initial-drop settings and per-copy conditions remain at that source path.
provenance.camera_metrics: fixed camera, 640x440 pixel-centre rays against original meshes; each bay uses its physical opening at front rim height; no content-dependent denominator

runtime_requirements: Read ossuary_layouts.json and display each chosen region prefix in its original drop order. Inventory remains 128 slots; runtime physics is unnecessary.
